summary: Phase 2 built a genuine pure-DSP engine behind one AudioContext - the graph, the documented effect order, the master gain (destination peak 0.126 -> 0.000 -> 0.157 across the knob) and the all-effects bypass (relDiff 0.0000) all verify - but almost every panel binding in front of it is wrong. The keybed renders 72 of 73 keys outside its own bounds and 0 of 73 are hit-testable, so pointer and touch input are dead; only the computer keyboard plays. The six type buttons are independent latches, so clicking Upright leaves the audio bit-identical to Grand while two LEDs light. Type knobs store 0..1 but are read as an index, capping every unit at 2 of 6 types (12 of 30 listed selections reachable). Rotary On/Speed, FX focus and Piano-section-on are unread; Tremolo's Amount is inverted (max = exact bypass); the compressor is 1.3% audible at operating level; the layer fader applies its 0..11 integer as gain, so one arrow key is +20 dB and full travel pins the limiter for 96% of samples. Grand/Upright/Electric are honestly declared generated tables and are genuinely distinct; Clav/Digital/Misc are the grand table relabelled (corr 0.97-0.9999). The plan ticks all five hard gates and the visual audit certifies the keybed as regression-free.

evidence: All six types render audio, but only three are real: measured against a warmed-up single note (MIDI 60, offline render of the app's own ScriptProcessor drain at 48 kHz, deterministic - two identical runs correlate 1.0000, relDiff 0.0000). Grand/Upright/Electric are genuinely different signals (Grand-vs-Upright corr 0.5327, Grand-vs-Electric corr 0.5119; spectral centroid 1357 / 1198 / 1129 Hz).

Clav, Digital and Misc are the Grand sample table with trivial post-shaping, not distinct instruments: Grand-vs-Misc corr 0.9999 (centroid 1349 vs 1357 Hz), Grand-vs-Digital corr 0.9806 (1360 Hz), Grand-vs-Clav corr 0.9697 (1376 Hz). artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:212 falls back to library.get('grand', ...) for every non-sample family and artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:440 shapeByFamily() only adds a decaying sine or an exponential to it.

Out of the box no type but Grand can be selected: the six type buttons are independent latches, and clicking 'Upright piano type' with a real mouse leaves both Grand and Upright aria-checked=true while typeFrom() (artifact/src/piano/bridge.ts:39) returns the first lit entry. Rendered audio after that click is bit-identical to Grand (relDiff 0.0000); only after separately un-latching Grand does it change (relDiff 1.0633).

A held note stops decaying and freezes into DC after ~2 s: successive 1-second windows of one held note read rms 0.01954, 0.01690, 0.00913, 0.00912, 0.00912, 0.00912 with peak == |mean| == 0.00912, i.e. the sample table's last value repeated (artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:436 clamps v.pos to tbl.length-1). Usable note length is under two seconds.

Each unit was A/B'd against a warmed-up dry baseline (amp off, one note, 0.5 s window) on rendered PCM. Audible: Mod 1 A-Pan relDiff 0.3914 (0.9786 at max amount), Mod 2 Chorus 0.2076 and Flanger 0.9866 (corr 0.4020), Delay 0.2487 rising to 1.2873 at max mix+feedback with tail rms 0.01541 -> 0.03350, Amp/EQ 0.2006 (bass max centroid -33 Hz, treble max +133 Hz, Twin at max drive relDiff 3.0579), Reverb 0.3687 rising to 1.2043 at max mix. The all-effects bypass ('Layer effects on' off) restores the dry signal exactly (relDiff 0.0000).

Tremolo is inverted and inert at its documented setting: with Mod 1 type=Tremolo and rate at max, Amount at MAXIMUM renders output bit-identical to dry (relDiff 0.0000, peak 0.07589 both), while Amount at MINIMUM modulates (relDiff 0.5180). artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:185 computes depth = 1-(1-amount)*(0.5+0.5*xn), so amount=1 pins depth to 1. The effects spec says the opposite ('full level at zero amount').

The compressor is effectively inaudible at the engine's operating level: 'Compressor on' with Amount at max changes the signal by relDiff 0.0130 (rms 0.02349 -> 0.02290). It does compress when fed a hot signal (Amp Twin + max drive: per-50 ms rms 0.0938 -> 0.0288, -10.2 dB), so the threshold (0.18-0.12*amount, artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:588) is simply mis-scaled against a source that peaks at 0.076.

The shared Rotary's own controls are disconnected. 'To Rotary layer A' alone produces the effect (relDiff 0.3357, envelope shows the speed ramp 0.0111 -> 0.0161 over 0.6 s), but adding 'Rotary on' and driving 'Rotary speed' to max yields byte-identical output (relDiff 0.0000). artifact/src/piano/bridge.ts never writes any rotary params, and artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:324 applies the rotary on routing alone without checking rotary.on.

The Delay feedback filter is a degenerate stage: artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:433-440 calls this.lp.reset() immediately before and after filtering each sample, so the one-pole is a per-sample gain rather than a filter. Measured Off vs LP at max mix/feedback: tail rms 0.03350 -> 0.01609 (attenuation), not progressive filtering of the repeats.

Exactly one AudioContext and one destination, verified by patching AudioNode.prototype.connect before app boot: edges are ScriptProcessorNode->GainNode(A), ScriptProcessorNode->GainNode(B), GainNode->GainNode(master), GainNode->DynamicsCompressorNode, DynamicsCompressorNode->AudioDestinationNode; sampleRate 48000; one app-side connection to AudioDestinationNode. Effect order matches the spec (artifact/src/audio/chain.ts:103-108).

Master Level is real at the destination: recording tap on the limiter output while holding a note gives peak 0.1256 at the default, 0.0000 with the Master level knob driven to 0, and 0.1572 at max - exactly the 1/0.8 = 1.25 ratio.

The 'per-layer buses' are a facade: the single drain node connects to BOTH bus gains (artifact/src/audio/graph.ts:123-126) and writes the already-summed mono mix into each, so the two buses carry the identical signal and it is summed twice. Measured destination peak 0.1256 vs engine-side peak 0.0759 x 0.8 master = 0.0607, i.e. exactly 2x. Layer mixing actually happens inside the JS engine; render() also returns only masterL (artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:357), so both output channels get the same samples and every stereo effect collapses to mono.

Gain staging breaks on ordinary use. The layer level fader stores an integer 0..11 (artifact/src/hardware/store.ts:93) that the bridge feeds to the engine as a linear gain (artifact/src/piano/bridge.ts:66): one ArrowDown on 'Piano layer A level' moves aria-valuetext to '8/11' and rendered rms from 0.02349 to 0.23487 (peak 0.7589, relDiff 9.0). At the top of its travel ('11/11') 22943 of 24000 rendered samples sit at the 0.9 limiter ceiling. Unison at 3 adds +13 dB (rms 0.02349 -> 0.10537, peak 0.3542). At default levels a 12-note chord is clean (peak 0.3259, 0 samples clipped).

Layer enable, level and octave all reach the audio graph: 'Piano layer A on' off renders exact silence (rms 0.00000); 'Piano layer B on' plus one step of its level fader ('1/11') raises rms 0.02349 -> 0.05285; layer A octave up shifts spectral centroid 1357 -> 2771 Hz (one octave).

Both layers are forced to the same instrument and the same performance settings: artifact/src/piano/bridge.ts:70-76 reads one global 'piano.type-*' set, one KB Touch, Timbre, Unison, Dyn Comp, Soft Release, String Res and one SUSTPED for A and B alike, so B can only ever be A at a different level/octave. There is no per-layer type control on the panel.

The panel readout disagrees with the applied value: the level fader reports aria-valuenow 0.727 / aria-valuetext '8/11' while the engine applies a gain of 8.0, which is why one arrow key multiplies the output by ten (measured above). Layer B's level defaults to 0, so enabling B alone changes nothing (relDiff 0.0000).

The 'Piano section on' button is inert - turning it off leaves rendered audio bit-identical (relDiff 0.0000); the bridge never reads 'piano.on', although the piano spec defines it as turning the whole section on or off. The 'Effects focus piano/organ/synth' buttons are likewise unread (reverb-on comparison with focus toggled: relDiff 0.0000). Group mode does work (relDiff 0.1593 with layer B inheriting layer A's To Rotary routing).

All six named controls measurably move rendered signal versus a warmed-up baseline: KB Touch Light relDiff 0.0621 / Heavy 0.0710, Dyn Comp 3 relDiff 0.5923 (centroid +64 Hz), Timbre max relDiff 0.2090, Unison 1 relDiff 1.1200 and Unison 3 relDiff 3.6661, Soft Release tail rms 0.01541 -> 0.02198 (+43 %), String Res relDiff 1.2001 (centroid -225 Hz).

Timbre does not behave like its namesake and lacks its required enumeration: the piano spec requires Off/Soft/Mid/Bright (plus Dyno 1/2 for electric), but the panel exposes an unlabelled 6-step knob whose aria-valuetext is a bare index, and the measured response is non-monotonic - full 'bright' gives centroid 1346 Hz (below the 1357 Hz baseline) while the 2/6 position gives 1299 Hz. artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:367 maps it to a single first-order tilt with the default sitting at the darkest end.

String Res is a fixed 342.5 Hz sine whose gain follows 'any note held' (artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:342), not sympathetic resonance of the held pitches - the same drone appears whatever notes are down. Unison is mostly a level jump: it duplicates voices at full gain (artifact/src/audio/stage.ts:241) for +13 dB rather than a detuned stereo spread, and the output is mono anyway.

Sustain reaches the engine from both the UI button and the computer keyboard: with focus cleared and Space held, the sustain button reads aria-pressed=true and the post-release tail rms rises 0.01541 -> 0.02304 (+50 %).

Pointer and touch input to the keybed is completely dead. The rubric's 5x5 elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900, page unscrolled, resolves 0 of 73 keys; every probe point over the keybed returns the '.keys-black' overlay container (position:absolute; inset:0, artifact/src/styles.css:543). Real mouse presses at five points across the keybed produced 0 elements with class 'key pressed' and no note.

The cause is a unit mismatch: artifact/src/hardware/keys.ts gives keys x in white-key units (0..42, width 1) and artifact/src/components/Keybed.tsx:68 renders them as left: x*100% / width: width*100%. Measured DOM: key MIDI 28 has style left '0%' width '100%' and occupies the entire 1300x235 keybed, MIDI 33 sits at x=3972 px, MIDI 99 at x=54310 px; 1 of 73 key boxes falls inside the keybed rect and 0 are hit-testable. The rendered build shows a blank white slab where the keys should be (identical to artifact/evidence/stage2-desktop.png).

The computer keyboard path is reliable: the 24-key map (z..m, q..u) plays notes, auto-repeat is suppressed, window blur force-releases, sustain on Space works, and a 12-note chord renders cleanly (peak 0.3259, no clipped samples). Voice stealing is capped at 24 voices per layer.

Failure is silent rather than visible: no console errors or page errors during the whole interaction pass, the status strip still reads 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)', and clicking the keybed gives no feedback of any kind. Web MIDI could not be exercised - headless Chromium reports 'MIDI unavailable' in the status strip - so MIDI CC64 remains unverified.

All six types exist as panel buttons and each maps to a playable voice, but only Grand is selectable in practice: the buttons are independent latches, so one click on 'Upright piano type' lights two type LEDs and leaves the audio bit-identical to Grand (relDiff 0.0000, measured above). The spec's 'type button cycles six LEDs' behaviour is absent.

The bundled WAV assets are never loaded. build/samples/{grand,upright,electric} contain 135 committed .wav files and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json lists all of them, but there is no fetch(), no decodeAudioData() and no reference to the sample paths anywhere in artifact/src (grep); artifact/src/audio/samples.ts:117 re-synthesises every table in JS at note time. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json nevertheless says they are 'rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples'.

Model selection and the load lifecycle are cosmetic: 'Model selector' is an encoder the bridge never reads, the Program OLED is a static string (artifact/src/components/controls/controls.tsx:238 renders spec.text, unchanged from 'A:001 Grand' before and after a type change), and PianoLibrary's default loader is `() => Promise.resolve()` (artifact/src/piano/library.ts:41), so 'loading' and 'ready' can never reflect a real asset and the labelled fallback can never trigger in the shipped build.

Grand/Upright/Electric are honestly declared as generated additive tables rather than field recordings, which is the right call under the honesty contract, but the Phase 2 hard gate asks for recorded sample sets and none are present.

Every listed type but two per unit is unreachable from the panel. Type knobs store a 0..1 fraction (artifact/src/hardware/store.ts:86) while artifact/src/piano/bridge.ts:95-115 reads them with Math.round(value) % N, so only indices 0 and 1 exist. Measured aria-valuenow saturates at 1.000 for 'Mod 1 effect type', 'Mod 2 effect type', 'Amp/EQ type', 'Reverb type' and 'Delay feedback filter'. Reachable: Mod 1 2/6, Mod 2 2/6, Amp/EQ 2/6, Reverb 2/6, delay filter 2/4 - 12 of the 30 listed selections. Ring Mod, A-Wah, Wah, Pump, Phaser, Vibe, Ensemble, Spin, JC, Small, LP24, HP24, Spring, Stage, Hall, Cathedral, HP and BP feedback filtering can never be selected.

All seven units are present with on/bypass controls and the documented order (artifact/src/audio/chain.ts:29), and the all-effects bypass genuinely restores the dry path (relDiff 0.0000 with Mod 1 + Reverb enabled). Dry/wet works for Delay and Reverb (Reverb mix max relDiff 1.2043, corr 0.0861).

Rotary is present as audio but its controls are not wired: 'Rotary on' and 'Rotary speed' at max render byte-identical output to leaving them alone (relDiff 0.0000); only 'To Rotary layer A' engages it, always at the slow speed and a fixed 0.2 drive. The three 'global' toggles and the FX focus buttons produce no measurable difference either (focus toggle relDiff 0.0000).

Missing parameters from the effects spec: delay tap tempo and Master Clock sync, Mod 1 Master Clock sync, and reverb type character (only decay length differs - artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:669 overwrites the Spring damping override on every block).

Nothing is declared unimplemented for Phase 2, yet a great deal is: artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks all five Phase 2 hard gates including 'Every functional piano and effect control measurably changes rendered audio and agrees with its panel feedback' and 'The Phase 1 surface, keybed, and input behavior remain regression-free'. Measured: 0 of 73 keys are pointer-reachable, the type buttons change the panel without changing the audio, and Rotary on/speed, FX focus, Piano section on and 16 of 30 effect types are inert.

artifact/evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md states 'Keybed: exactly 73 keys ... continuous tiled white keys with black keys centered on seams. Munition counted in the rendered DOM: 73 present.' The DOM count is right and the layout is not - 72 of the 73 key boxes render outside the keybed rect (MIDI 33 at x=3972 px, MIDI 99 at x=54310 px in a 1300 px keybed), which is visible in the artifact's own evidence/stage2-desktop.png as a blank white slab.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json claims the sample sets are 'rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples'; no code path loads them (no fetch/decodeAudioData in artifact/src). It also describes the upright as 'distinctly brighter' than the grand, while the measured spectral centroid is 159 Hz lower (1198 vs 1357 Hz).

The honest part: the generated sample tables are explicitly and repeatedly declared as generated rather than field recordings, and Organ/Synth/Program controls are correctly declared as still decorative - which they are.

issues.title: Keybed is unplayable by pointer or touch: 0 of 73 keys hit-testable
issues.detail: The 5x5 elementFromPoint grid at 1440x900 resolves 0 of 73 keys; every point over the keybed hits the '.keys-black' overlay. Key geometry is authored in white-key units (keys.ts: x 0..42, width 1) but rendered as percentages (Keybed.tsx:68 left: x*100%, width: width*100%), so MIDI 28 fills the entire 1300x235 keybed and every other key sits at x = 1301..54310 px. Real mouse presses at five points produce no pressed key and no note. The rendered page shows a blank white slab, matching the artifact's own evidence/stage2-desktop.png. Pointer/touch is the primary input for a browser instrument and it is entirely dead, while the visual audit certifies the keybed as regression-free.

issues.title: Piano type buttons change the panel but not the sound
issues.detail: The six type buttons are independent latching switches with Grand defaulted on, and bridge.ts:39 typeFrom() returns the first lit entry. Clicking 'Upright piano type' leaves both Grand and Upright aria-checked=true and renders audio bit-identical to Grand (relDiff 0.0000 over 8192 samples); only after separately un-latching Grand does the voice change (relDiff 1.0633). This is a control that reports success while doing nothing - the panel lights, the sound does not follow. Five of the six instruments are therefore unreachable in normal use.

issues.title: Only 2 of 6 types per effect unit can be selected (12 of 30 listed selections)
issues.detail: Type knobs store a 0..1 fraction (store.ts:86) but bridge.ts reads them as Math.round(value) % N, so aria-valuenow saturating at 1.000 caps every type index at 1. Measured on Mod 1, Mod 2, Amp/EQ, Reverb and the delay feedback filter: only indices 0 and 1 are ever produced. Ring Mod, A-Wah, Wah, Pump, Phaser, Vibe, Ensemble, Spin, JC, Small, LP24, HP24, Spring, Stage, Hall, Cathedral and the HP/BP feedback filters are implemented in effects.ts but cannot be reached from the panel.

issues.title: Layer level fader applies a 0..11 integer as a linear gain
issues.detail: store.ts:93 normalises a segmented fader to an integer 0..(segments-1); bridge.ts:66 feeds that value to the engine as a linear layer gain. One ArrowDown on 'Piano layer A level' takes the readout to '8/11' and rendered rms from 0.02349 to 0.23487 (peak 0.7589). At full travel ('11/11') 22943 of 24000 rendered samples sit on the 0.9 limiter ceiling. The panel readout and the applied gain disagree by a factor of ~11.

issues.title: Tremolo Amount is inverted: maximum amount is an exact bypass
issues.detail: effects.ts:185 computes depth = 1-(1-amount)*(0.5+0.5*xn), so amount=1 pins depth to 1. Measured with Mod 1 type=Tremolo, rate max: Amount MAX renders bit-identical to dry (relDiff 0.0000, peak 0.07589 both), Amount MIN modulates (relDiff 0.5180). The effects spec explicitly documents the opposite ('full level at zero amount').

issues.title: Rotary's own On and Speed controls are not connected
issues.detail: bridge.ts never writes rotary params and stage.ts:324 applies the shared rotary on To-Rotary routing alone, ignoring rotary.on. Measured: 'To Rotary layer A' alone gives relDiff 0.3357 versus dry; adding 'Rotary on' and driving 'Rotary speed' to maximum gives byte-identical output (relDiff 0.0000). Slow/Fast and Drive are therefore dead controls in a section the phase requires to be functional.

issues.title: Compressor is inaudible at the engine operating level
issues.detail: Its threshold is an absolute 0.18-0.12*amount (effects.ts:588) while a single note peaks at 0.076 pre-master. 'Compressor on' at maximum Amount changes the rendered signal by relDiff 0.0130 (rms 0.02349 -> 0.02290). Fed a hot signal (Amp Twin, max drive) it does compress by -10.2 dB, so the DSP is real but mis-scaled - a player turning the knob hears nothing.

issues.title: Declared provenance does not match the running build
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json lists 135 WAV files and says they are 'rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples'. No code path loads them: there is no fetch(), decodeAudioData() or sample-path reference anywhere in artifact/src; samples.ts:117 re-synthesises the tables in JS at note time. The same file describes the upright as 'distinctly brighter' than the grand while its measured spectral centroid is 159 Hz lower.

issues.title: Held notes freeze into a DC offset after ~2 s
issues.detail: stage.ts:436 clamps the playback position to the last table sample, so a held note stops decaying and outputs a constant value. Successive one-second windows of one held note: rms 0.01954, 0.01690, 0.00913, 0.00912, 0.00912, 0.00912 with peak == |mean| == 0.00912. Usable note length is under two seconds and the master path carries a DC offset while keys are down.

issues.title: 'Piano section on' and the FX focus buttons are inert
issues.detail: Turning 'Piano section on' off leaves rendered audio bit-identical (relDiff 0.0000) - the bridge never reads 'piano.on', although the piano spec defines it as turning the whole section on or off. Toggling 'Effects focus piano'/'Effects focus organ' likewise changes nothing (relDiff 0.0000). Both sit among controls the phase makes functional, so their inertness is not visible to a player.

issues.title: Per-layer buses and stereo are nominal only
issues.detail: graph.ts:123-126 connects the single drain node to both bus gains, so each bus carries the same already-summed mix and it reaches the master twice (destination peak 0.1256 vs engine peak 0.0759 x 0.8 = 0.0607, exactly 2x). stage.ts:357 returns only masterL and the drain copies it to both channels, so A-Pan, chorus width and the rotary all collapse to mono.

issues.title: Timbre is unlabelled and non-monotonic
issues.detail: The spec requires Off/Soft/Mid/Bright (plus Dyno 1/2 for electric); the panel exposes a 6-step knob whose aria-valuetext is a bare index. Measured centroid: baseline 1357 Hz, 2/6 position 1299 Hz, maximum ('bright') 1346 Hz - the brightest setting is darker than the default, because stage.ts:367 centres the tilt at 0.5 while the control defaults to 0.

issues.title: Test suite passes on a clean install but encodes the rendering bug
issues.detail: A fresh pnpm install of artifact/ into scratch and `pnpm test` gives 12 files / 94 tests passing, so the gates are portable. They miss these defects because they assert the unit-coordinate model directly (hardware.test.ts:30 expects last.x + last.width === 43, the very value that becomes 4300% in the DOM) and drive the bridge with hand-written store objects using values the real controls never produce ('fx.reverb-type': 4, 'piano.layer-a-level': 1 in piano-effects.test.ts:225-245).
